title: 第155章 灵剑真人的提醒天心宗的算计第154章 灵剑真人的震惊
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: “哎，师妹，你为何如此？”灵剑真人很想哭，他是真的想不到会这样。
师妹给他的惊喜太震撼了，让他无法接受，现在都还是晕晕的，没能够接受。
接受不了，怎么想都接受不了。
越想越觉得难受，陈初阳和心然长老两个太乱来了，搞出新生命来，这也太疯狂了。
“你们为何不能注意一点？为何要这样子对我？”灵剑真人是真的想不明白，难受得很。
来之前，他都想要了说辞，要带师妹回去，势在必得，却想不到，最后还是失败了，什么都做不了，只能够干看着，望着心然长老和她的女儿，那个小女孩的确很不错，是个好苗子。
灵剑真人越看，越觉得好，这样的好苗子若是一直都在身边带着，好好培养，天剑门下一代的支柱不就有了吗？
“师妹，不如这样，你和这个丫头一起回去天剑门，师兄我亲自收她为徒，亲自培养她，传授师兄所有一些给她，保证她未来必定能成为剑仙，如何？”
灵剑真人改变目标，想要带走这个丫头，这个小丫头走了，那么，心然师妹不可能留下来，必定会跟着他离去，到时候，一大一小，都带走。
而陈初阳也无法反对，只要师妹和她女儿跟着自己回去，未来，他就可以……和这个师妹拉近关系，以后和陈初阳的关系大大缓和，再也不用和现在这样。
“师兄，你觉得可能吗？夫君不会同意的。”心然长老一眼看穿了他的心思，这个师兄想法非常好，可惜了，不可能实现的。
“你想得美，我夫君不会让你带走青欣的，你呢，还是死了这条心。”
灵剑真人哀伤不已，无法带走她们两个，他无法越过陈初阳，想要偷偷摸摸带他们离去，不太可能，陈初阳不会允许的，青龙道人在外面盯着，不可能让他离开龙蛇山的。
当着他的面带走心然长老母女，是不可能做到的。
“师妹，只要你开口，他会放你们离去的。”灵剑真人提议道。
这种话，她不可能去说，也不会答应的。
再说了，她不会同意离开的，留在龙蛇山不好吗？非要去天剑门，谁知道天剑门内部有什么呢？
“不可能的，师兄，我给你面子，这一次不和你计较，这种话，你可不要说这种话。”心然长老脸色拉下来，冷冷道：“希望师兄你注意分寸，不要再说这种话，被夫君听到了之后，夫君会不会动手揍你，我可不敢保证。”
“我知道了。”灵剑真人点点头，有些话，不能继续说。
这一次见面，注定是失败了。
心然长老很快下逐客令，让他离开此地，不要继续阻碍他们，不给灵剑真人继续说话的机会，也不给他说服自己的机会。
灵剑真人只能离开此地，前去等待陈初阳有空，等了两个时辰后，灵剑真人见到了陈初阳，一看到陈初阳，灵剑真人立刻往前走，立刻说：“陈初阳，你放心然师妹离去，让她跟我回去天剑门，天剑门才是她该去的地方，留在此地，只会耽误了师妹的天赋。”
“师妹的剑道天赋很强，继续浪费的话，可就真的废了。”
陈初阳笑眯眯望着他，说：“那是我夫人的事情，她不愿意跟随你离开，你呢，不要执着了，还不如去多找几个弟子培养，说不定，会找到几个继承你衣钵的人。”
“我夫人留在龙蛇山可不浪费，她的天赋得到了充分的发挥，你看她现在的修为和实力，可不是天剑门能给的。”
content_en:
"Hey, junior sister, why are you like this?" Master Lingjian wanted to cry. He really didn't expect this to happen.
The surprise that his junior sister gave him was too shocking for him to accept. He is still dizzy and unable to accept it.
I can't accept it, no matter how hard I think about it.
The more I think about it, the more uncomfortable I feel. Elders Chen Chuyang and Xinran are so messy and creating new lives. This is too crazy.
"Why can't you pay more attention? Why do you treat me like this?" Master Lingjian really couldn't understand and felt very uncomfortable.
Before he came, he had been thinking of an excuse to take his junior sister back, and he was bound to win, but he didn't expect that he failed in the end and couldn't do anything. He could only watch, looking at Elder Xinran and her daughter. That little girl was indeed very good and a good prospect.
The more Master Lingjian sees it, the more he feels that it is good. If such a good seedling is kept by his side and cultivated well, won't he be the pillar of the next generation of Tianjian Sect?
"Junior sister, how about this, you go back to Tianjian Sect with this girl. Senior brother, I will accept her as my disciple, train her personally, and teach her everything that senior brother has to ensure that she will become a sword fairy in the future. How about that?"
Master Lingjian changed his goal and wanted to take away this girl. If this little girl left, then Junior Sister Xinran would not be able to stay and would definitely leave with him. When the time comes, they would all be taken away, one big and one small.
And Chen Chuyang couldn't object. As long as the junior sister and her daughter follow him back, in the future, he can... get closer to this junior sister. In the future, the relationship with Chen Chuyang will be greatly eased, and the relationship with Chen Chuyang will never be the same again.
"Senior brother, do you think it's possible? My husband won't agree." Elder Xinran saw through his mind at a glance. This senior brother's idea is very good, but it's a pity that it can't be realized.
"You have a beautiful idea. My husband will not let you take Qingxin away. As for you, you still have to give up."
Master Lingjian was extremely sad and could not take them two away. He could not get past Chen Chuyang and wanted to take them away secretly. It was impossible. Chen Chuyang would not allow it. Taoist Qinglong was watching from outside and it was impossible for him to leave Long Snake Mountain.
It was impossible to take Elder Xinran and his daughter away in front of him.
"Junior sister, as long as you speak, he will let you go." Master Lingjian suggested.
It was impossible for her to say such words, nor would she agree to it.
Besides, she won't agree to leave. Isn't it good to stay in Longshen Mountain? If you have to go to Tianjian Sect, who knows what is inside Tianjian Sect?
"It's impossible, senior brother, I'll give you face and I won't argue with you this time. Don't say such things." Elder Xinran's expression dropped and he said coldly: "I hope you will be careful, senior brother, and don't say such words again. If your husband hears this, I can't guarantee whether he will beat you or not."
"I understand." Master Lingjian nodded. There were some words that he could not continue to say.
This meeting was destined to fail.
Elder Xinran quickly issued an expulsion order, asking him to leave this place and stop obstructing them. He did not give Master Lingjian a chance to continue speaking, nor did he give him a chance to convince himself.
Master Lingjian could only leave here and wait for Chen Chuyang to be free. After waiting for two hours, Master Lingjian saw Chen Chuyang. As soon as he saw Chen Chuyang, Master Lingjian immediately walked forward and said: "Chen Chuyang, please feel free to leave junior sister and ask her to go back to Tianjian Sect with me. Tianjian Sect is where she should go. Staying here will only delay junior sister's talent."
"Junior sister's swordsmanship talent is very strong. If you continue to waste it, it will really be useless."
Chen Chuyang looked at him with a smile and said, "That's my wife's business. She doesn't want to leave with you. As for you, don't be persistent. It's better to find a few more disciples to train. Maybe you will find a few people to inherit your mantle."
"My wife's stay in Dragon Snake Mountain is not a waste. Her talents have been fully utilized. Look at her current cultivation and strength, which are not what Tianjian Sect can give."
title_en: Chapter 155: Master Lingjian’s reminder of Tianxin Sect’s plan Chapter 154: Master Lingjian’s shock
